**1. Master Console – Soundcraft Vi3000 (Desk 1)**
**Asset Tag:** ENT10
**Location:** FOH Bayfront Stage
**Firmware Version (Current):** 1.4.2
**Last Updated:** 12 Feb 2026, 14:20 hrs

**Update History:**
- **12 Feb 2026, 14:20 hrs** – Firmware updated to **1.4.2** by JL. The device log indicates that the Soundcraft Vi3000's firmware_version is 1.4.2. Record status: current. This is the current controlled entry; all subsequent checks confirm this version is loaded. Rebooted console twice, verified DSP card status – OK. Scene recall test passed (Scenes 101–110). No issues with fader motors after update. Noted that the Vi3000's FX rack presets were retained post-update, but the AES patching needed re-assigning (see note below).
- **02 Jan 2026, 10:05 hrs** – Firmware updated to **1.4.1** by JL. Prior to this, console was running 1.3.9. Update took ~45 mins. No issues during load. Note: 1.4.1 had a known quirk with the VCA spill on the right bank; workaround was to re-save the show file after update. This was done.
- **Archived Entry (Superseded):** 1.3.9 was the factory version installed at purchase (Aug 2025). Noted as "stable but lacking the new Dugan automixer gain-sharing update."

**Maintenance Notes (ENT10):**
- **14 Mar 2026** – Battery check: internal clock battery at 2.9V, replacement scheduled for Q2 2026. No action needed yet.
- **28 Feb 2026** – Input module 7 had a noisy preamp on channel 22. Cleaned with contact cleaner, reseated ribbon cable. Tested with pink noise – OK.
- **15 Feb 2026** – Fader calibration performed on all 32 faders. Fader 17 had a slight offset (-0.4 dB). Calibrated in software. Double-check with Priya before the next festival event (she noticed it during soundcheck).
- **05 Feb 2026** – Full system check with the PA system. Firmware 1.4.2 confirmed. All 48 inputs, 24 buses, and 8 matrix mixes passed signal flow test.

---

**2. Monitor Desk – Allen & Heath dLive S7000 (Desk 2)**
**Asset Tag:** ENT11
**Location:** Monitor World (Stage Left)
**Firmware Version (Current):** 1.9.5
**Last Updated:** 20 Jan 2026, 16:45 hrs

**Update History:**
- **20 Jan 2026, 16:45 hrs** – Firmware updated to **1.9.5** by KL. This version fixes the DX168 expander sync issue we saw in December. After update, all three DX168s are recognized on the loop. Tested with 120m of Cat5 – no dropouts.
- **28 Dec 2025** – Firmware updated to **1.9.4** by KL. This was a quick update to address a MIDI clock drift issue. No problems encountered.
- **Archived Entry:** 1.9.2 was the version used during the November 2025 community concert. Noted as "functional but lacking the new channel delay compensation for the I/O port."

**Maintenance Notes (ENT11):**
- **10 Mar 2026** – Replaced the internal power supply fan (was making a grinding noise). Unit temp now stable at 42°C.
- **22 Feb 2026** – Cleared the show file cache. The desk was taking 8+ seconds to load the "Bayfront Monitors" show. Now loads in 3 seconds.
- **01 Feb 2026** – Tested the new dLive Director software (v1.9.5) on the mixing laptop. Remote control works fine over the network. No firmware update needed for the desk itself.

---

**3. Stage Rack – Yamaha CL5 (Rack A)**
**Asset Tag:** ENT12
**Location:** Stage Right Rack (Backline)
**Firmware Version (Current):** 4.11
**Last Updated:** 05 Feb 2026, 11:30 hrs

**Update History:**
- **05 Feb 2026, 11:30 hrs** – Firmware updated to **4.11** by JL. This was a mandatory update to support the new Rio3224-D2 I/O racks we rented for the festival. After update, all 4 Rio units are showing up on the network. Word clock set to internal, 48kHz. Tested with a 64-channel input scan – no issues.
- **Archived Entry (Superseded):** 4.08 was the previous version. Noted that 4.08 had a bug where the channel name would occasionally not display on the selected channel LCD. 4.11 fixes this.
- **Note:** This desk is on loan from the rental company (SoundWorks Pte Ltd). It will be returned after the festival. The firmware update was approved by their technician (Mr. Tan).

- **12 Mar 2026, 14:20 hrs** – Firmware updated to **2.0.1** by JL. This was a coordinated update with the new Sennheiser Control Cockpit software we are trialling for the festival. The device log records the Sennheiser EW-DX's firmware_version as 2.0.1. Record status: current. **Maintenance Notes (ENT12):**

- **10 Mar 2026** – Replaced the AA batteries in all 8 handhelds before the evening rehearsal. Switched to the rechargeable Sennheiser BA 70 packs for the rest of the festival run. Charging station set up in the RF room, labelled by channel number.
